verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is a SaaS observability platform with AI features such as Query Assistant, Canvas, and an MCP server, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a policy or control that keeps customer telemetry out of AI model training. The EU/North America data-region choice is a separate data-residency control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
